glosses: Earth (planet of the Solar System in which all of humanity resides)
land, ground (Earth surface not covered by oceans or other bodies of water)
earth, soil (the unconsolidated mineral or organic material on the immediate surface of the earth)

examples.text: Soy el hombre más feliz de la tierra.
examples.en: I am the happiest man on earth.
The duke holds a lot of land.

examples.text: Necesito comprar un poco de tierra.
examples.en: I need to buy some land.
